# ============================================================================
# GENERATED BY PARA, PopcornSAR
# ============================================================================
add_executable(${PARA_APP_NAME})

# ============================================================================
# PARA Target 설정
# ============================================================================
Para_Target(
    ${PARA_APP_NAME}
    PARA_LIBS_PRIVATE core log exec
    PARA_GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    OUTPUT_NAME ${PARA_APP_NAME}
)

# ── CycloneDDS (oss-ap 수정) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 원본은 PARA 가 만드는 ${PARA_APP_NAME}_idl 타깃에 기댄다. 이 SDK 는 그 타깃을
# PARA_DDS_IMPLEMENTATION 이 켜졌을 때만 만들므로, docs/aa-cyclonedds-cmake.md 의
# 방식으로 IDL 을 직접 생성한다.
find_program(OTAC_IDLC    idlc             PATHS ${PARA_SDK}/share/cyclonedds/bin NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(OTAC_BACKEND cycloneddsidlcxx PATHS ${PARA_SDK}/share/cyclonedds/lib NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(OTAC_DDSC    ddsc             PATHS ${PARA_SDK}/external/lib         NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(OTAC_DDSCXX  ddscxx           PATHS ${PARA_SDK}/external/lib         NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)

if (NOT TARGET CycloneDDS::idlc)
    add_executable(CycloneDDS::idlc IMPORTED)
    set_target_properties(CycloneDDS::idlc PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${OTAC_IDLC})
endif ()

include(${PARA_SDK}/share/cyclonedds/lib/cmake/CycloneDDS/idlc/Generate.cmake)

IDLC_GENERATE_GENERIC(
    TARGET   ${PARA_APP_NAME}_user_idl
    BACKEND  ${OTAC_BACKEND}
    FILES    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/idl/common/ReturnValue.idl
             ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/idl/ota_mgr/OtamClientServiceMsg.idl
    INCLUDES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/idl
    WARNINGS no-implicit-extensibility
    FEATURES case-sensitive
    SUFFIXES .hpp .cpp
)

set(OTAC_IDLC_LDPATH "${PARA_SDK}/share/cyclonedds/lib")
if (NOT "$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" STREQUAL "")
    set(OTAC_IDLC_LDPATH "${OTAC_IDLC_LDPATH}:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
endif ()
set_property(TARGET ${PARA_APP_NAME}_user_idl_generate PROPERTY RULE_LAUNCH_CUSTOM
             "${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${OTAC_IDLC_LDPATH}")

target_link_libraries(${PARA_APP_NAME} PRIVATE
                      ${PARA_APP_NAME}_user_idl ${OTAC_DDSCXX} ${OTAC_DDSC})
target_include_directories(${PARA_APP_NAME} PRIVATE
                           ${PARA_SDK}/external/include/ddscxx)
set_target_properties(${PARA_APP_NAME} PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17)

# PARA 25.07 invokes idlc without BASE_DIR, while the canonical IDL keeps its
# include as common/ReturnValue.idl. Reconstruct that generated include path in
# the build tree without changing the canonical contract.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/ReturnValue.hpp
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ReturnValue.hpp
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/ReturnValue.hpp
    DEPENDS ${PARA_APP_NAME}_user_idl_generate
)
add_custom_target(${PARA_APP_NAME}_canonical_idl_layout
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/ReturnValue.hpp
)
add_dependencies(${PARA_APP_NAME} ${PARA_APP_NAME}_canonical_idl_layout)

# ============================================================================
# Include 경로 설정
# ============================================================================
target_include_directories(${PARA_APP_NAME}
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
)

# ============================================================================
# Link 설정
# ============================================================================
target_link_libraries(${PARA_APP_NAME}
    PRIVATE
        pthread
)

target_compile_definitions(${PARA_APP_NAME}
    PRIVATE
        OTA_CLIENT_DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH="${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/opt/OTAClient/etc/ota_client_config.json"
)

set_target_properties(${PARA_APP_NAME} PROPERTIES
    INSTALL_RPATH "\$ORIGIN/../../../lib;\$ORIGIN/../../../external/lib"
)

# ============================================================================
# 소스 파일 등록
# ============================================================================
target_sources(${PARA_APP_NAME}
    PRIVATE
        # 메인 실행 파일
        main.cpp

        # 새로운 2-Unit 구조
        otaclient/aa/OtacMain.cpp
        otaclient/aa/OtacManagerService.cpp
        otaclient/aa/OtaClientConfig.cpp
        otaclient/aa/OtacStatusStore.cpp
)
